g.text: R12 (5.1 kohm) bleeds D1's reverse leakage off VBUS, so a 5V-pin supply does not fake a USB host.

g.desc: R12 (5.1 kohm) bleeds D1's reverse leakage off VBUS, so a 5V-pin supply does not fake a USB host.

g.text: GPIO6-11 are the module's internal flash pins and are not led out: J2 16-18, J3 17-19 are NC.
